```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[very thick, line cap = round]
    \def\Lx{6}
    \def\Ly{4}
    \def\a{2}
    \def\h{1.75*\Ly}

    \draw[mydarkblue,samples=100,variable=\x,domain=0.3:\a*\Lx]
        plot(\x/\a,{\h*(sin(deg(\x))/(\x*\x*\x) - cos(deg(\x))/(\x*\x))});
    \draw[mydarkblue] (0,0.334*\h) node[text=black, left] {$1$} -- (0.3/\a,0.33*\h);

    \draw[->] (0,0) -- (\Lx,0) node[right] {$k_{\text{F}} \abs{\vb{r}}$};
    \draw[->] (0,-0.25*\Ly/2) -- (0,0.75*\Ly);
    \node[mydarkblue] at (0.3*\Lx,0.5*\Ly) {$g(\vb{r},0)/n$};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
